title: Pista GP RR Winter Test 2005

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The AGV Pista GP RR Winter Test 2005 is designed to deliver razor-sharp aerodynamics in a chin-on-tank tuck, purpose-built for riders demanding uncompromising high-speed aerodynamic stability and track-certified protection. Built around a Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell weighing a featherweight 1289g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~92 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.06, FIM benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

product_details.description: Exact replica of the helmet worn by MotoGP professionals.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for a tight, aggressive track fit with minimal cheek volume; requires specific padding to accommodate winter liners. Runs slightly small compared to street versions due to aerodynamic shell shaping. Optimized for Intermediate Oval head shape.

technical_analysis: Features 100% 3K Carbon Fiber shell construction developed under AGV Extreme Safety protocol for MotoGP performance paired with Class-1 optical Ultravision shield offering 190° horizontal and 85° vertical field of view. The interior utilizes 360° Adaptive Fit crown structure with 2Dry moisture-wicking Shalimar & Ritmo fabric lining with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the AGV Pista GP RR Winter Test 2005: combining Italy 🇮🇹 craftsmanship with Class-1 optical Ultravision shield offering 190° horizontal and 85° vertical field of view and 360° Adaptive Fit crown structure with 2Dry moisture-wicking Shalimar & Ritmo fabric lining. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: AGV Pista GP RR Winter Test 2005: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the AGV Pista GP RR Winter Test 2005. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner with emergency quick-release cheek pads (EQRS) for swift removal by first responders.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.

Lightweight shell construction reduces neck strain on long rides
Plush, fully removable and washable antimicrobial cheek liners

introduction: Positioned in AGV's Track / Race lineup, the Pista GP RR Winter Test 2005 brings Italian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06, FIM track safety.
story:
The AGV Pista GP RR Winter Test 2005 represents AGV's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~92 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber Track / Race helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the AGV Pista GP RR Winter Test 2005 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
